perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.description: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

enhanced.name: One-Two Punch
enhanced.description: Hitting a target with nearly every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

enhanced.name: Bewildering Burst
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Lead from Gold
enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Cascade Point
enhanced.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for an improved duration.

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

enhanced.name: Ancillary Ordinance
enhanced.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. More missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Grave Robber
enhanced.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves. Improves handling.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

enhanced.name: Proximity Power
enhanced.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant an improved amount of bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

enhanced.name: Trench Barrel
enhanced.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, improved handling, and improved reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.description:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for a duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

enhanced.name: All-Star
enhanced.description:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for an improved duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch
enhanced.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

enhanced.name: Swashbuckler
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage for an improved duration from melee final blows and defeating targets with this weapon.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.
